quest.title: Festering Desire
quest.description: After your journey up Dragonspine, you and Paimon prepare to head back to the adventurer camp in the foothills to have a look.
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x60, Hero's Wit x3, Mora x30000

chapter.num: The Chalk Prince and the Dragon: Act I
chapter.title: Festering Desire

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Huh? Look at that, {NICKNAME}! Looks like someone made camp here. Are other people adventuring nearby?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's see how our fellow explorers are doing!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, it's Sucrose!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are you here to explore the Snowy Mountain too?

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Aah! Y—You scared me... Please, don't scare me like that! I was giving my research report some much-needed consideration.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But you were just standing over there, staring into space...

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: N—Not at all! I was just thinking of a name for a new subspecies of Sweet Flower I propagated. It has seeds that are four times as large as normal.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Oh, are you interested? Wonderful! Next time, please allow me to show you the fruits of my work!

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: It's a shame. If I wasn't coming to this mountain, I would've brought some samples with me...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, weren't you doing research in the city? How come you're here?

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Timaeus and I were helping Albedo organize research data. Timaeus just left, in fact. You didn't run into him?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sure didn't.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: He said that he wasn't as sharp as Albedo when it came to data — by quite a long shot, in fact.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: The significance of some things Albedo is able to grasp almost immediately, but we on the other hand take considerable time. I fear that this must be the difference in our knowledge and experience showing...

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Timaeus seemed rather depressed about the matter. He said he was going to take a walk, so I'm currently settling the leftover affairs myself.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (It feels like he's just leaving her high and dry...)

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: I was originally going to take a look around myself after finishing up here, but unexpectedly, I gleaned some interesting data from these reports!

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: But, well... *sigh* Guess my search for secrets will have to wait...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Secrets? Ooh, what secrets?

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Hmm... Actually, do you two have time right now?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't have anything on us but that!

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Then could I ask you for a favor? In truth, I feel like Albedo is... concealing something from myself and Timaeus.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But isn't he your teacher? What would a teacher have to hide from his students?

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: That's true, but I feel like he's always hiding something... It is my personal guess that it is some great secret of alchemy!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait. How're you so sure?

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Timaeus and I are both passionate researchers of alchemy. If it was anything else, Albedo wouldn't have any reason to hide it from us.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... You do have a point.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Could you help me investigate what it is that Albedo's hiding? Please! I'm... I'm just too curious!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... What do you think?

choices.text: If the lady wishes it, we shall do it.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Yes! Thank you, thank you!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright, alright. Let's take a little trip, shall we?

choices.text: I'm curious about Albedo's secret stash myself.
Can you eat that, I wonder?

talks.objective: Find Albedo and learn his secret

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Albedo!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hey there. It's us again.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Hmm? Why are you here?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Are you lost?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No we're not!

choices.text: Sucrose has commissioned us to probe you for secrets.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: A secret?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! What are you doing!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Our mission calls for a delicate approach!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Well, we weren't fooling him either way.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh... Sure, but still...

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Actually, you've arrived at just the right moment. I have business with you too, in fact.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Here you go.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? What's this?

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: As you can see, it is a sword.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: I did not make this sword. However, I did add some alchemical touches to it.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Would you like to try it out?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You're giving it to me?

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: My research indicates that this sword has some... unique properties. Only you can use it.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: But I need to gather data from it quite urgently — so, could I bother you to use it in battle?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Waaait a second. How can there be a sword that only one person can use?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Any adverse side effects?

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Very astute of you. This sword has indeed had a curse laid upon it.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: An ordinary person would be unable to wield it at all. However, you are an exception.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh...?

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Or perhaps I should say that only you are immune to the curse. As such, who could I find to help me, if not you?

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: We gain little from saying more. Go find some monsters nearby — after all, some things are best discovered through practice.

choices.text: Is smithing part of an alchemist's qualifications, too?
Sucrose says that you conceal some unspeakable secret.

talks.objective: Take up the mysterious sword and do battle

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Now that's rich — Treasure Hoarders calling us thieves!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: They certainly arrived quickly.

choices.text: Wait, you're the thief they were talking about?

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Goodness, no.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: They seem to have been talking about this sword. What's going on?

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Why are you looking at me like that? Of course I didn't steal this sword.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Not long ago, the Knights caught a band of Treasure Hoarders outside the city. The goods they were smuggling were also impounded.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: This sword was one of those items. We believed it to be stolen plunder, but no one came to claim it, nor could we find out where it came from, so it languished in our stores.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: I noticed it quite by chance while in our storehouse. To tell you the truth, such an old sword would see little use outside of alchemy.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? You claimed it for yourself, just like that?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So... then what happened? You just took it with you?

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Indeed, and I initially intended to perform some experiments on it, but I unexpectedly discovered its true origins in the process.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: This ancient-looking weapon once passed through the hands of a now-deceased blacksmith. It is a legendary magical sword.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: A magical sword!?

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: It is said that the smith vanished not long after creating the weapon, with the weapon subsequently becoming lost to time.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Working backwards from its eventual fate as plunder, one can guess that it was then stolen by the Treasure Hoarders, where it remained in obscurity till recently.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The blacksmith who made this weapon... disappeared!? That's kinda spooky.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No wonder it's cursed!

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Exactly.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: To think that humans could make such a weapon...

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Do you know the story of <color=#00E1FFFF>Durin</color> and this mountain?

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: <color=#00E1FFFF>Durin</color> was the black dragon who menaced Mondstadt, before finally being defeated by the combined efforts of <color=#00E1FFFF>Dvalin</color> and the <color=#00E1FFFF>Anemo Archon Barbatos</color>.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: After a fierce battle, the vanquished Durin crashed to ruin here, falling into the thick snow.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Snow gathers atop this mountain and never melts, which is a most curious phenomenon. Which leads one to wonder — was Durin's fall here purely by chance, or was it intent?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Could it really have been intent?

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Perhaps this place was chosen as a gravesite precisely so that the snow's power could seal the corrosive toxin coming from Durin's body.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: It seems plausible that Barbatos would think of such a method.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh... Was Barbatos such a capable god?

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Well, these are just my postulations. I don't have any evidence. But what's for certain is that this mountain and Durin are deeply intertwined.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: In fact, I believe that the very sword in your hand has Durin's remains in it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: A dragon's remains!?

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Indeed. The dragon's eyes, claws, and scales, ground into dust before being used to coat the blade.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: In this way, Durin's corruption and venom entered into the sword, and became the source of its power.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: This is very advanced craftsmanship. I presume that having successfully forged the weapon, the smith must have tried it out themselves in their joy.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: But using this sword in battle would have allowed the corruption to seep through the blade's handle, and into their bodies.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Ordinary mortals cannot withstand such power. The blacksmith must then have fled, driven mad by the curse, before meeting their end in some unknown place.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eek...

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: You've purified Dvalin's Tears before, which is a very rare ability indeed.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: This ability has protected you from being corrupted or poisoned, and you can completely eliminate their effects.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Which is why you, and only you, can properly wield this sword.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Still, this sword really is huge... Yikes!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: I—It's glowing!

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: As far as I'm concerned, this is where the real experiment begins.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: This sword is still very weak at present. However, it is able to absorb energy, and through that, it is able to constantly become stronger.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: In some sense, you could even say that it is a living thing.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Well then, Traveler, adventure with it to your heart's content. I need you to help it grow.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: I believe that we will soon have all the proof that we need.

choices.text: You didn't filch anything from them, did you?

dialogues.speaker: Ferocious Man
dialogues.text: Over here! It's with this brat!

dialogues.speaker: Ferocious Man
dialogues.text: Give it back, you thief!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Treasure Hoarders? There are Treasure Hoarders in a place this cold?

dialogues.speaker: Ferocious Man
dialogues.text: Enough talk! Hand it over!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Watch out!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: How about those over there?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon still has a bad feeling about this...

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Albedo's secret must be something truly extraordinary. But if that's the case, why the secrecy in the first place?
